newsitem.title: UK: GDR REPORT-Profit taking pulls Indian GDRs down.
newsitem.headline: GDR REPORT-Profit taking pulls Indian GDRs down.

text.p: Indian global depositary receipts eased in slower trade on Monday amid profit-taking and after falls in local stocks, traders said.
They said the market lacked triggers for further gains, following a recent strong run and mild profit concerns had undermined sentiment.
"The market has had a strong run and it was due for a breather," said one dealer.
He said weakness had appeared in VSNL, SAIL and Reliance, with Grasim finding late interest to end mildly better.
VSNL lost 57 cents to $19.25/$20.25 and SAIL was 43 cents softer at $9.65/$10.40.
The HSBC James Capel Indian GDR index JCEAI closed 0.78 points lower at 87.82, down 0.88 percent, with the premium over the local market narrowing to 20.85 percent from 22.21 percent.
Bombay's benchmark index rose shed 32.37 points to 4,291.45.
The HSBC James Capel Korea GDR Index closed 0.72 points softer, down 0.91 percent, at 78.33 points, a premium of 41.81 percent over the local market.

The Capel Taiwan GDR Index finished 3.97 points higher at 129.18, representing a discount to the local market of 2.15 percent. The local market's weighted index touched a seven year high on Monday, before drifting off highs to close 0.7 percent up.
